name: W.W.C.F. World Championship
epitaph: The fed's own top prize changed hands four times across two January 1996 newsletters, running through five recorded reigns -- Masked Mayhem lost it, regained it, and lost it again -- with The Executioner recognized as champion when the surviving record breaks off, an upcoming title defense against The Hitman still unresolved in-corpus.

name: W.W.C.F. Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Held by Robbie "Boston" Cooper going into the fed's first house card, the strap passed to Tecker there and survived a disqualification challenge before "The Fantasy" Brett Young won it by manager interference on the fed's second recorded house-show date, the last title change in the surviving record.
